list.name: platform_os
list.label: OS
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform_os FROM builds WHERE platform_os IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: platform_build
list.label: Build Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT platform_build FROM builds WHERE platform_build IS NOT NULL AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: arch
list.label: Arch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT arch FROM builds WHERE arch IS NOT NULL AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(branch,'(none)') FROM builds WHERE platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: fork
list.label: Fork
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(fork,'(none)') FROM builds WHERE platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: test_suite
list.label: Suite
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT t.suite FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS builds FROM builds WHERE $__timeFilter(build_ts) AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote})

SELECT count(*) AS failures FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote})

SELECT count(DISTINCT (t.suite, t.name)) AS distinct_failing FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote})

panels.title: Flaky tests (>= min flips)
panels.description: Tests whose pass/fail status flipped at least 'Min flips' times across builds in range, on the same platform.

targets.rawSql: WITH o AS (SELECT suite,name,run_context,platform_os,platform_build,arch,branch, lag(status) OVER (PARTITION BY suite,name,run_context,platform_os,platform_build,arch,branch ORDER BY build_ts) AS prev, status FROM test_runs WHERE status IN ('pass','fail') AND $__timeFilter(build_ts) AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote})), f AS (SELECT suite,name,platform_os,arch,branch, count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND status<>prev) AS flips FROM o GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) SELECT count(*) AS flaky FROM f WHERE flips >= ${min_flips}

SELECT b.build_ts AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='fail') AS "failures" FROM builds b JOIN test_results t ON t.build_id=b.build_id WHERE $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote}) GROUP BY b.build_ts ORDER BY b.build_ts

SELECT t.suite AS "Suite", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='fail') AS "Failures" FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id=t.build_id WHERE $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote}) GROUP BY t.suite HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status='fail') > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Flakiest tests -- pass/fail flips across builds
panels.description: A flip is a pass<->fail change between consecutive runs of the same test on the same platform. flips > 0 means the test fails sporadically (the PS-10541 signal). Click Test to open the latest build's Jenkins testReport.

targets.rawSql: WITH o AS (SELECT suite,name,run_context,platform_os,platform_build,arch,branch,build_number,build_ts,status, lag(status) OVER (PARTITION BY suite,name,run_context,platform_os,platform_build,arch,branch ORDER BY build_ts) AS prev FROM test_runs WHERE status IN ('pass','fail') AND $__timeFilter(build_ts) AND platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote})) SELECT suite AS "Suite", name AS "Test", platform_os AS "OS", arch AS "Arch", branch AS "Branch", count(*) AS "Runs", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='fail') AS "Fails", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pass') AS "Passes", count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND status<>prev) AS "Flips", max(build_number) AS "Last build" FROM o GROUP BY suite,name,platform_os,arch,branch HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND status<>prev) >= ${min_flips} ORDER BY "Flips" DESC, "Fails" DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Failing tests x builds
panels.description: Every failing test occurrence in range. Click Build/Test to open Jenkins.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b.build_number AS "Build", t.suite AS "Suite", t.name AS "Test", t.worker AS "Worker", b.branch AS "Branch", t.failure_message AS "Error" FROM test_results t JOIN builds b ON b.build_id = t.build_id WHERE t.status='fail' AND $__timeFilter(b.build_ts) AND b.platform_os IN (${platform_os:singlequote}) AND b.platform_build IN (${platform_build:singlequote}) AND b.arch IN (${arch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.branch,'(none)') IN (${branch:singlequote}) AND COALESCE(b.fork,'(none)') IN (${fork:singlequote}) AND t.suite IN (${test_suite:singlequote}) ORDER BY b.build_number DESC, t.suite, t.name
